Jeez, Eve, you think you can stop controlling people for five seconds? College bud Mary (who's internal narrator voice is very different from her spoken voice) has to tackle her friend Mary's psychosis of controlling every aspect of the men she dates. I didn't find the film especially derogatory to women (other than the fact that Eve is, you know, nuts).
